top_signals.title: Dollar Gains Stand Out as Stocks, Bonds, Oil Waver: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks barely moved as Brent crude struggled for direction after its longest losing streak this year, with traders waiting for the US and Iran to move closer to ending their war. The dollar hit the highest level since July.
